list.name: browser_selector
list.label: 浏览器流选择器（接入时核验）

options.content:
**待 TEST Cloud 接入验证；不是线上验收完成。** 本机已核验固定版本 Faro → Alloy → Loki 的日志字段。Cloud 托管浏览器入口需再核对实际流标签/格式，browser_selector 不得凭空猜测。无数据不等于0次失败。按同环境、版本、入口、网络/平台层比较，成功P50/P95与终态样本量一起看；低样本只观察，不自动排名或作人员考核。默认24h/5min，避免高频长窗查询。

开始/终态按窗口计数，**不是逐请求闭环或全访问覆盖**（无身份关联，窗口边界和丢报可影响结果）。先观察24–48h基线，再审核预算；后台、离页和主动停止单列。

首字是正文或已开启思考进入匹配消息的React commit，不是像素/阅读证明。完整回复另算；首字到达不保证最终成功。聊天入场见页面看板/chat/:id，角色点击反馈不能冒充数据可用。前端不发模型ID，模型/平台下钻见后端。

panels.title: 首字已知终态成功率
panels.description: 主动停止、后台、离页、替换单列，不计入已知服务结果分母；拒绝与失败须看构成表。

targets.expr: (sum (count_over_time(${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_roleplay_terminal" | logfmt | kind="event" | event_name="st_roleplay_terminal" | app_name="st-miniapp" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | event_data_measurement_version="$measurement_version" | event_data_stage="first_token" | event_data_outcome="observed" [$__range])) or vector(0)) / sum (count_over_time(${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_roleplay_terminal" | logfmt | kind="event" | event_name="st_roleplay_terminal" | app_name="st-miniapp" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | event_data_measurement_version="$measurement_version" | event_data_stage="first_token" | event_data_outcome=~"observed|timed_out|upstream_error|server_timeout|fallback_timeout|primary_timeout" [$__range]))

panels.title: 首字全部终态样本构成

targets.expr: sum by (event_data_action,event_data_outcome) (count_over_time(${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_roleplay_terminal" | logfmt | kind="event" | event_name="st_roleplay_terminal" | app_name="st-miniapp" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | event_data_measurement_version="$measurement_version" | event_data_stage="first_token" [$__range]))

quantile_over_time(0.5, ${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_roleplay_first_token" | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="st_roleplay_first_token" | app_name="st-miniapp" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="$measurement_version" | context_outcome="observed" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__auto]) by (context_action)

quantile_over_time(0.95, ${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_roleplay_first_token" | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="st_roleplay_first_token" | app_name="st-miniapp" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="$measurement_version" | context_outcome="observed" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__auto]) by (context_action)
